Off Script - A Crowd Work Series by Rakesh Addlakha
"Modern Family" - Stand Up Comedy By Rakesh Addlakha | Crowd Work | Stand Up Comedy
Hey everyone, it's me, Rakesh Addlakha, and I'm back with my latest video of 2024. Join me for some clean jokes and family-friendly fun. You'll love watching as I chat with the crowd, turning their stories into hilarious comedy. If you're looking for the best stand-up comedy with lots of laughs and crowd interaction, you don't want to miss this video! Come join me for a fun time with some awesome people!
